author: AuroraPerego
body:
With the warning added in https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52201, @Parsifal-2045 found some missing data dictionaries for TICL data formats. This PR adds them to avoid the slowdown that he noticed.
By looking at the additions, I'd say the two `edm::Ptr` come from members of the `TICLCandidate`, while the `std::vector<std::array<unsigned int, 2>>` are the `ticl::Trackster edges.

No change in the physics output is expected.
title: Add missing dictionaries for TICL
